applied.fact: Approach led with the Burgundy Col trail, which the same text calls the descent; every other field starts at the Silver Star Creek pullout

before.approach: The Burgundy Col trail starts from the Wine Spires pullout near milepost 166: find a faint boot path descending loose talus/scree to the east into the trees, passing a trail register, then crossing Early Winters Creek on a log (~4,080 ft). The trail climbs the timbered rib north of Burgundy Creek, steeply gaining elevation to a basin/camp bench around 6,500 ft (roughly 2 hours from the car), then continues up to Burgundy Col (~7,720 ft, ~3 hours). Good camping and a late-season spring are near 6,400-6,500 ft. For Clean Break this trail is the usual way down; the way in to Juno Tower's east face is up Silver Star Creek from the pullout where SR-20 crosses the creek near milepost 171, about 8.5 miles east of Washington Pass.
